about: Levels whose scene glbs always stay on this PC: evict_levels.py never evicts them (features/mesh-asset-size, 'Local eviction'). Keys are tree ids (bf1942 = viewer/maps, else viewer/maps/mods/<id>) and level directory names; values say why. Built 2026-10-20 from every level the tests, lab scenarios, perf benches, e2e specs and memory-recorded verification fixtures load from the real trees, plus three per tree for local play: by recorded popularity where the repo records it (fhsweurope only, two levels, features/fhsweurope-extraction 2026-10-19), else the first three rows of the tree's maps.json. Add a level here before a test or a scenario starts depending on it.

bf1942.wake: lab scenarios (wake-coop, capture-wake, sidecar-wake*, mapchange, levelchange); tests/test_room.py, room_harness.mjs, test_sim_vehicles.py, test_level_nodes.py, server_statics_harness.mjs, ground/supply harnesses; perf/perfbench, leakcheck, contextloss, cadencecheck, fogprobe; server.mjs default level; memory: landing craft, soldier sweep, runner flip, sidecar harness
